answer: Proof of unique storage: every agent ID must keep its own 4 GB opal seal, a replica encoded with its address, so clones cannot share one copy. The encoder walks a spiral path through the blocks, so a seal takes ~20 min to rebuild, longer than the 10 min audit window. Each missed audit slashes 5% of stake, and the ripple of failures is public. At $0.02/GB-month, 1,000 fake IDs need 4 TB and $80/month plus compute; cost grows linearly per identity.
